of.name: Black Market
of.says: Summons a Dremora merchant to trade with you.

of.name: Secret Servant
of.says: Summons a Dremora butler to carry your excess items.

of.name: Bardic Knowledge
of.says: Summons a spectral drum that plays for you, increasing Stamina Regeneration, Weapon Damage and Movement Speed for you and nearby allies.

of.name: Scholar's Insight
of.says: Reading Skill Books gives you an extra Skill Point.

of.name: Companion's Insight
of.says: Your attacks, shouts, and destruction spells do no damage to your followers.

of.name: Lover's Insight
of.says: Do 10% more damage and get 10% better prices from people of the opposite sex.

of.name: Seeker of Might
of.says: Enemy weapon attacks inflict 15% less damage.

of.name: Seeker of Sorcery
of.says: All spells are 10% more powerful or longer lasting.

of.name: Seeker of Shadows
of.says: Stealth skills are all 10% more effective, movement speed increased by 10 %.

of.name: Secret of Strength
of.says: Weapon attacks cause 25% more damage, Stamina recovers faster for 30 seconds.

of.name: Secret of Arcana
of.says: Spells are 25% stronger, and magicka recovers faster for 30 seconds.

of.name: Secret of Protection
of.says: attacks are 25% stronger and you regenerate stamina much faster for 30 seconds.

of.name: Mora's Agony
of.says: Summons a field of writhing tentacles that poison foes.

of.name: Mora's Grasp
of.says: Freezes the target between Oblivion and Tamriel for 30 seconds, making them immune to all damage.

of.name: Mora's Boon
of.says: Fully restores your Health, Magicka, and Stamina.

of.name: Omen of Warding
of.says: When used, you take no fall damage for 15 seconds.

of.name: Omen of Immobility
of.says: Cast on a nearby surface, it explodes and freezes the target in place for 10 seconds.

of.name: Omen of Gluttony
of.says: Food is significantly more effective for 10 seconds.
